items.text: ESG and business sustainability careers involve measuring and reporting environmental, social and governance performance, calculating emissions, auditing supply chains and advising firms on cleaner and fairer practices, and they reward people who combine data skill, reporting standards and credible, honest communication.
Learn one reporting framework, practise carbon and data calculations and build a sample sustainability report for a small organisation.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
